name: enum-group-value-an-importer-makes
description: A program that imports a library, which the analysis does not read, can convert any integer to an enumerated type the library exports from an importable package, so a member whose deletion renumbers an exported member is retained. A member after the last exported member renumbers nothing an importer or the library names, so it is reported whatever values importers make. A member of an unexported type no importer can name, used only by comparison, is reported.
